# Life Ledger · Deep Review 1.0

**Understand your past. Shape your future.**

Life Ledger 1.0 is the first stable release of the local-first habit and reflection PWA. It is ready for everyday personal use, works immediately from the public local-only site, and can optionally synchronize through infrastructure you control.

## What is included

- Daily habits with checklist or measured tracking, flexible schedules, effective-dated targets, notes, ordering, and mobile paging
- Daily goals, mood with an optional reason, journal entries, and event notes
- Weekly planning, completed-item history, written output, and archived reviews
- Monthly habit comparison, focus-time analysis, charts, and heatmaps
- Named focus topics and a local-first timer that records invested minutes
- Validated JSON backup and restore, including full restore, partial merge, and an undo safety copy
- English, Simplified Chinese, and German interfaces
- Light, dark, and system appearance with responsive desktop and mobile layouts
- Installable offline PWA behavior
- Optional self-hosted synchronization with Cloudflare Access + D1 or Tencent CloudBase
- A public product roadmap that keeps AI, voice, photos, and contextual data optional and privacy-aware

## Three ways to use it

1. Open the public local-only PWA with no account or setup.
2. Download or clone the source for local development.
3. Deploy to your own Cloudflare or CloudBase account for private cross-device synchronization.

## Upgrading from the beta

No data migration is required. Existing browser and synchronized records continue to load, and JSON backups created by earlier beta releases remain importable.

The PWA cache is versioned for 1.0. If an installed copy briefly shows the previous interface, close and reopen it once so the service worker can activate the new app shell.

## Known platform boundaries

- Concurrent offline edits currently use latest-write-wins synchronization.
- Reminder reliability depends on the operating system and browser PWA implementation.
- Local-only data belongs to one browser origin and does not synchronize unless the user deploys a supported cloud option.
- AI-assisted reflection, voice check-ins, photo attachments, and weather context are roadmap items rather than 1.0 features.

Private journal exports should never be attached to public GitHub issues.
